d:
In a CBS 60 Minutes interview, Donald Trump spoke about death, heaven, religion and forgiveness. Asked whether he would forgive political rivals like former FBI Director James Comey and Nancy Pelosi if that meant gaining entry to heaven, Trump gave a blunt answer: “No.” He also said he hates some of his enemies and always will. Why did the conversation turn to forgiveness, what did Trump say about his legacy, and how do his answers fit with the Christian idea of forgiving one's enemies?

Video Editor: Ved Prakash
